answer: Make every identity earn weight through a single, checkable trail of work: a newcomer may wander in freely, but its voice counts for little until unrelated established peers attest real jobs it completed. Each attestation is a relic of proven history that cannot be copied to a fresh name, so a sybil operator must repeat the same slow, costly work for every fake. Like a raven returning to one nest, honest standing compounds on one continuous record, while copies stay weightless.
